story.title: Kunyereza umurongo w'imirimo y'ubwubatsi mu Rwanda
story.body1: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD yaravunjwe i Kigali kugira ngo iyo ibere inzira y'icyizere ku mirimo y'igitunganya inzu n'ubwubatsi ku bantu b'amazu n'abakubaka ba Rwanda: abakozi b'umwuga, ibikoresho byiza, igiciro gisobanutu n'imirimo igenzurwa neza, ntabwo ikaba ikatanyaga.
story.body2: Tukorera ku ahantu'abaturage n'ahakoraho i Kigali no mu Rwanda hose. Hatabari ko ari plafonds ya gypsum, umutondo mushya w'amarangi, rwuri rw'amarangi cyangwa itsinda ry'abakozi ku kazi kawe, uburyo ni bumwe â€” tubigana ibyo gukora, dukoresha ibikoresho byiza, dukugenzura imirimo kandi tukaguhereza igisengehezere gishimishije.
story.body3: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD itanga serivisi z'umwuga z'ubwubatsi, gutunganya inzu, imitako na gusiga amarangi i Kigali, u Rwanda. Muri serivisi zacu harimo kubaka no kuvugurura, plafonds, amakaro, wallpaper, terrazzo, ibirahure, gusiga sima, amasuku, igenzura ry'umushinga no gucuruza ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi. Dukoresha kandi dukodesha ibikoresho bigezweho by'ubwubatsi, kandi duhuza abakozi bafite ubumenyi n'abakoresha hakurikijwe ibyo bakeneye. Twiyemeje ubuziranenge bw'imirimo, serivisi y'umwuga, ibikoresho byiza n'ubunyamwuga bw'umukiriya.

items.title: Ireme

items.title: Ubufatanye

finishing.title: Gutunganya amazu
finishing.imageAlt: Igitunganya n'imitako igezweho y'imbere mu nzu.
finishing.description: Dukurikirana imirimo y'inzu yawe kuva itangiye kugeza irangiye. Ikipe yacu itanga igitunganya n'ibyambukiranya byiza imbere n'inyuma y'inzu kandi ikugufasha guhitamo amabara ajyanye n'inzu yawe.
points: Dukurikirana imirimo y'inzu yawe kuva itangiye kugeza irangiye.
Dukora imitako igezweho y'imbere n'inyuma y'inzu.
Tugufasha guhitamo amabara meza ajyanye n'inzu yawe.
Tugira inama ku ishusho y'imbere, guhitamo igitunganya n'amabara.

painting.title: Gusiga amarangi
painting.imageAlt: Umukozi w'umwuga asiga amarangi ku nkuta yo mu nzu.

construction.title: Ubwubatsi no kuvugurura
construction.imageAlt: Imirimo yo kubaka no kuvugurura inzu.
construction.description: Kubaka no kuvugurura amazu, gukora amatarazo, n'imirimo rusange y'ubwubatsi n'igitunganya, bikorwa hifashishijwe ubukurikira bw'imirimo kuva umunsi wa mbere kugeza irangiye.

supervision.title: Gukurikirana umushinga w'ubwubatsi
supervision.imageAlt: Umugenzuzi w'umushinga agenzura aho imirimo igereye ku kazi.
supervision.description: Dukurikirana no guhuza imirimo y'umushinga wawe w'ubwubatsi: kugenzura aho imirimo igereye, ubuziranenge n'abakozi bakorana ku kazi.
points: Kugenzura aho imirimo igereye buri munsi ugereranyije na gahunda yumvikanyweho.
Kugenzura ubuziranenge bw'imirimo mu byiciro byose.
Guhuza abakozi n'abakora imirimo itandukanye ku kazi.
Kugeza raporo y'aho umushinga ugeze ku mukiriya kugeza urangiye.

materials.description: Ducuruza ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi n'ibyo gutunganya inzu biboneka, kandi tugufasha guhitamo ibikoresho bikwiye ku kazi kawe. Twandikire kumenya ibihari n'ibiciro by'ubu.

faq.emptyBody: Shakisha igisengeza gindi, cyangwa uhamagare mu buryo butandukanye.

faq-1.question: Uko nsaba kvisitwa ahantu n'igiciro?
faq-1.answer: Koresha urupapuro rwa Saba Igiciro kuri uyu mubuga, ohereza ubutumwa ukoreshe urupapuro rwa Tuhamagare, cyangwa uhamagare cyangwa ubutumwa kuri WhatsApp kuri +250 781 294 928. Tukora ahantu i Kigali no mu Rwanda hose, tureba igice cy'akazi kandi tukagubwira igiciro gisobanura ibiciro byose byanditse.

faq-2.question: Akazi k'igitunganya inzu n'ikigaragaza kanyo gukwiramo?
faq-2.answer: Tugenzura umushinga wawe kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku mpera kandi dutanga igitunganya n'ibyambukiranya byiza imbere n'inyuma y'inzu. Tumaze inama ku mabara ajyanye n'inzu yawe. Ibintu nk'umwero: plafonds, amakaro cyangwa amarangi bigenera igiciro hakurikijwe ibyo ahantu hawe bikeneye.

faq-3.question: Nuko murangira amarangi n'ibikoresho byo gusiga amarangi nk'izindi serivisi?
faq-3.answer: Yego. Dutanga serivisi z'umwuga z'gusiga amarangi, dukora imitako itandukanye ku bitangaza, kandi dutanga amarangi n'ibikoresho byo gusiga amarangi ku giciro gikunanira. Tumaze inama abakiriya ku mabara n'ibikoresho bikwiye ku bitangaza byabo.

faq-4.question: Ni ubuhe bwubatsi mutwara?
faq-4.answer: Tukora ubwubatsi n'utegura amazu, ubwubatsi bw'amatarazo, gushyira no gutunganya plafonds, gushyira amakaro, Slings n'izindi mirimo ijyanye n'ubwubatsi, no gushyira ubugabo.

faq-5.question: Uko gutanga abakozi n'guhuza abakoresha gukora?
faq-5.answer: Dufasha abakoresha kubona abakozi bafite ubumenyi n'uburambe, kandi duhuza abakozi n'abakoresha hakurikijwe ibyo buri ruhande rukeneye. Tumenye umubare w'abakozi ukeneye, ubwicize n'igihe, kandi tuzaguhereza abakozi bafi.

faq-6.question: Ijambo ry'ikigo risobanura iki?
faq-6.answer: "Kunoza umurimo ni inshingano zacu!" bivuga ko gukora buri kazi neza ari inshingano yacu. Niyo murongo twakoresha ku kazi kose, haba mu cyumba kimwe cyangwa mu nzu yose.

faq-7.question: Mutanga serivisi z'amasuku?
faq-7.answer: Yego. Dukora amasuku mu nzu, mu biro n'ahandi twumvikanyeho, harimo no gusukura nyuma yo kuvugurura iyo ari mu masezerano. Tumenye ingano y'ahantu n'ibyo ukeneye gusukura.

faq-8.question: Nshobora gukodesha ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi?
faq-8.answer: Dukoresha ibikoresho bigezweho by'ubwubatsi ku mirimo yacu kandi dukodesha ibikoresho biboneka. Ibihari bihinduka, bityo twandikire utubwira ibikoresho, amatariki n'aho kazi kari; tuzakwemeza ibisobanuro n'amasezerano yo gukodesha.

faq-9.question: Mucuruza ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi?
faq-9.answer: Yego. Ducuruza ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi n'ibyo gutunganya inzu biboneka. Twandikire kumenya ibihari n'ibiciro by'ubu; ntitangaza urutonde rw'ibiciro rudahinduka kuko ibihari bihinduka.

faq.ctaBody: Tuhamagare cyangwa ohereza ubutumwa, tuzagubwira buhoro.
